_comment: mushroom_dip is the only path by which continentalness drops below the continent_base floor of -1.02 (which sits above the vanilla mushroom_fields upper edge of -1.05). mushroom_dip fires only at tectonic ridge tips (tectonic_potential near 0) that are also deep ocean (continent_base < -0.75) and on the far-side tectonic segment half (tectonic_segments > 0.55). All three gates must align to produce a dip below -1.05.
